before_statement:
Let $R$ be Noetherian, $M$ finite, and $I,J$ ideals contained in the Jacobson
radical. If $\sqrt I=\sqrt J$, then
$$\operatorname{depth}_I(M)=\operatorname{depth}_J(M),$$
including the value $\infty$.
after_statement:

including the value $\infty$.
